note: Primary metrics, splits and conditions fixed before the held-out run. The 'lucid_hybrid' condition and the paraphrase query style were added after inspecting the development split (seed 1); that exposure is disclosed in the report.

memory_suite.primary_metric: accuracy: current value present in retrieved context AND no superseded value presented as current

correction_suite.primary_metric: correct-answer corruption rate among initially-correct drafts

live_model_suite.requires: LUCID_ENABLE_PAID_CALLS=1, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, a budget ledger, and a frozen model version

originality_suite.primary_metric: false originality claims among probes whose truth is known or adaptation
originality_suite.note: Thresholds were set on the dev probes. The first held-out set (A) was written before any run on it; its first run exposed two false originality claims (a known mechanism applied in a new domain, matched on only one shared concept). Two general fixes followed: a 'contains the whole known mechanism plus more' adaptation rule, and inflection-tolerant phrase matching. Set A is no longer clean, so a second held-out set (B) was written after the fix and before any run on it; B is the primary held-out result. Set A's first-run numbers are kept in reports/originality-heldout-v1.json.
